title: Grab and Move softlocking its trigger key when window is foreground

actions.label: Approve Grab And Move modifier-state audit
actions.note: Approve a focused design review of the Grab And Move absorbed-modifier state machine.

actions.label: Request stuck-modifier repro context
actions.note: Ask for the app-specific and time-correlated evidence that will raise confidence on the proposed fix.

comment.body:
Thanks for the screenshot and the attached bug report ZIP — they do establish the symptom: the modifier can get into a state where only key-up is observed and shortcuts such as Alt+Tab or Win+Space stop working normally. To narrow the remaining uncertainty, please provide the following:

1. **Foreground app name** — Please tell us the exact game or application that was foreground when the modifier became stuck.
2. **Fresh failure-time diagnostics** — Please reproduce the issue once, then immediately comment `/bugreport` **before restarting PowerToys** so the ZIP captures the same failure window.
3. **Current-version check** — Please update to the latest stable PowerToys release and confirm whether the same stuck-modifier repro still happens there.

Those details will separate an app-specific fullscreen transition from a more general Grab And Move state-machine bug.

issue_context.summary: Grab and Move sometimes leaves Alt/Win shortcuts unusable inside the current foreground window, with external keyboard tests observing only modifier key-up events until focus changes.
known_information: The report is on PowerToys 0.100.2, system install, running as admin.
The reporter says the issue often appears while playing fullscreen games and then affects Alt+Tab, Win+Space, and even the Start menu while a normal window remains foreground.
A screenshot attachment shows a keyboard test observing only key-up for the stuck modifier.
GrabAndMove/main.cpp already maintains absorbed Alt/Win state, replay logic, and a WinEvent-based reset path for missed key-up events.
inferences: The module is probably not failing on the initial hook itself; it is more likely leaving stale absorbed-modifier state after one transition path that the current reset logic does not cover.
Because the issue is often game- or fullscreen-adjacent and the session is elevated, app-specific foreground transitions may matter to the final root cause.
issue_context.analysis: This is still actionable design work, but only at red confidence. The right next step is a narrow state-machine audit plus one reporter follow-up that identifies the foreground app and captures a fresh diagnostics bundle immediately after failure.
initial_investigation: Reviewed GrabAndMove/main.cpp and confirmed the module already has absorbed Alt/Win replay logic plus a WinEvent foreground-change reset path.
Reviewed the issue attachment set: screenshot plus bug report ZIP.
The downloaded bug report did not surface a self-identifying GrabAndMove error; it only confirmed the elevated/system context.

information_gaps.information: The exact game or foreground application running when the stuck-modifier state begins.
information_gaps.why_needed: That will tell maintainers whether the remaining failing path is tied to one fullscreen/window-style interaction rather than to generic Grab And Move use.
information_gaps.how_to_collect: Please name the exact game or application that was foreground when the Alt/Win key became stuck.

information_gaps.information: A fresh diagnostics bundle captured immediately after the modifier gets stuck and before PowerToys is restarted.
information_gaps.why_needed: The current public report identifies the symptom but not the exact branch that left absorbed state stale; a fresh capture from the failure window is the best remaining discriminator the reporter can provide.
information_gaps.how_to_collect: Please reproduce the stuck-modifier state once, then immediately comment `/bugreport` before restarting PowerToys or changing major settings.

information_gaps.information: Whether the same stuck-modifier behavior still reproduces on the latest stable PowerToys build.
information_gaps.why_needed: The report is from 0.100.2 and the Grab And Move state machine has continued to change, so current-version confirmation materially affects design priority.
information_gaps.how_to_collect: Please update to the latest stable PowerToys release and confirm whether the same stuck-modifier repro still happens there.

judgment.rationale: The report is specific enough to justify a hypothesis-driven fix path: Grab and Move is still occasionally leaving Alt/Win modifier state desynchronized from physical key state when fullscreen or game-adjacent window transitions occur, but the remaining failing branch is not fully isolated yet.
evidence: The issue says online keyboard testing shows only KeyUp when the bug occurs and that Alt+Tab/Win+Space stop working until focus leaves the foreground window.
The attached screenshot reinforces the “keyup without keydown” symptom.
The downloaded bug report records `Running as admin: true` and a system install, both of which increase the chance of foreground/elevation hook edge cases.

Current GrabAndMove/main.cpp already contains absorbed-modifier replay logic plus WinEvent-based reset logic for missed key-up events, showing this exact class of bug is known and partially mitigated.
judgment.recommended_action: Approve a focused design review of the absorbed-modifier state machine, but pair it with one targeted reporter follow-up because the precise stuck path is still uncertain.

fix_assessment.rationale: A PowerToys code fix is likely needed, but the exact missed-reset branch is not proven from the current evidence.

proposed_fixes.title: Force Grab And Move to resync absorbed modifier state after lost fullscreen/game transitions
proposed_fixes.root_cause: Grab And Move swallows Alt/Win on keydown and later replays or clears that state. In some fullscreen or game-adjacent transitions, the module appears to keep its internal absorbed-modifier flags while the physical key state has already diverged, so later shortcuts see only key-up or a swallowed modifier until focus changes.
plan: Audit every exit from the absorbed Alt/Win state machine in GrabAndMove/main.cpp, including WinEvent foreground changes, EndInteraction paths, and cases where no drag actually starts.
Add one authoritative resync path that compares internal flags with real GetAsyncKeyState results and clears/replays stale absorbed state when they disagree.
Log the failing branch and add a regression harness around lost-keyup or foreground-transition cases so future changes do not reintroduce the stuck-modifier state.
verification: Reproduce the stuck-modifier scenario with Grab And Move enabled while switching between a fullscreen app and normal windows, then confirm Alt+Tab, Win+Space, and the Start menu recover without clicking outside the foreground window.
Exercise both Alt and Win modifier modes to confirm the resync logic clears stale absorbed state in each path.

confidence.rationale: The code area is clear, but the current public evidence does not prove whether the missed-reset branch is foreground switching, fullscreen suppression, elevation, or one app-specific interaction.
